metadata.title: ARM Holdings earnings setup: Key item to watch for this oversold stock

content.text:
Investing.com -- Arm Holdings ADR (ARM) reports after the close today, Nov 4. The stock arrives deeply damaged. It closed at $202.49 on Nov 3 and was indicated at $200.10 (-1.18%) pre-market as of 9:09 AM EST. It is down -34.15% over 1M and -14.16% over 1W, and about -40% from the $336.98 high on Sep 23. Market cap is about $216.4B. Figures are as of the Nov 3 close unless stated.
The Earnings Bar
-
Consensus: EPS $0.41 on revenue of $1.07B.
-
Beat streak: The last quarter (Jul 29) delivered EPS of $0.45 vs $0.37 and revenue of $1.29B vs $990M. The stock still slipped -1.31%.
-
Past reactions: Over four prints the moves were -1.54%, +6.05%, +2.14% and -1.31%. Beats have not reliably produced rallies.
-
Estimates: Revisions are barely positive (+0.48% over 30 days), so there is no big upgrade cycle to unwind. The next-quarter consensus is EPS $0.46 and revenue $1.14B.
The real swing factor is guidance, not the beat. A SoftBank preview dated Aug 3, 2026 flagged that Arm had warned smartphone royalties would fall in coming quarters. AI data-center demand was masking that mobile weakness. Read more (Aug 3, 2026). The bear case is more royalty softness. The bull case is that a -34% month has already priced a lot of this in.
Technical Picture
The trend is clearly bearish, but momentum is stretched.
-
Moving averages: The price sits below every key average on the daily chart. The EMA 20 is at 231.86, the SMA 50 at 257.07 and the SMA 200 at 229.87. The stock lost the 200-day in late October, so it is now overhead resistance.
-
Trend strength: ADX is 26.6 with -DI (35.7) well above +DI (16.8). That points to a trend with real sellers behind it.
-
Oversold readings: The daily RSI is 35.4. Stochastic is at 11.8 and Williams %R at -87. Oversold readings can persist in a downtrend, but they raise the odds of a relief bounce.
-
Capitulation volume: Volume hit 10.6M on Oct 30 (a gap down to $206) and 6.3M on Nov 2, which set the swing low of $196.12.
-
Weekly: The weekly gauge is also Strong Sell, with Stochastic RSI at 0.
